label: bench-32-holmes-native-proxy-timeout
diagnosis:
### Observations
1. Pod `billing-api-665595bbf9-dk4wf` logs repeated `WARN db connection reset by peer, retrying (pool acquire ...)` alongside memory pressure warnings (`fetch_pod_logs`).
2. Deployment `billing-api` configures `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` at 900 seconds (`demo-apps/billing-api`).
3. DBProxy resource `billing-db-proxy` sets `spec.idleClientTimeout` to 600 seconds (`ack-system/billing-db-proxy`).

### Ruled-out leads
1. Pod out-of-memory or crash restarts: container status shows 0 restarts and `Running` (`demo-apps/billing-api-665595bbf9-dk4wf`).
2. Load balancer idle timeout: raised to 120 seconds in change ID `CI-2455` and unrelated to database connection resets.

### Root cause
The database connection pool idle timeout (900 s) exceeds the RDS Proxy `idleClientTimeout` (600 s), causing unexpected connection drops.

### Recommended action
The billing team should lower `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` in `billing-api` below 600 s (per runbook ID `RB-014`).
